'''Heinrich Ferdinand Scherk''' (27 October 1798 &ndash; 4 October 1885) was a [[Germans|German]] [[mathematician]] notable for his work on [[minimal surface]]s and the distribution of [[prime number]]s. He is also notable as the doctoral advisor of [[Ernst Kummer]].
